workflow: User opens v17 workbench and manually adjusts amp_scale, time_scale, shift_days, anchors, and windows.
User saves/downloads JSON after each good alignment.
Codex imports reviewed cases and derives default rules/search ranges.

default_constraints.rule: time_scale is global per case; no segment warp unless user explicitly validates it

cases.name: Peak: 2021 top -> 2025 top
cases.question: Does the full peak-before and peak-after path visually align?

cases.name: Bottom: 2022 bear low -> 2026 local low
cases.question: Does bottoming structure before/after the low align?

cases.name: Lower high: 2022 rebound high -> 2025 lower high
cases.question: Does the rebound-high / second-high structure align?

cases.name: Capitulation: 2022 Jun low -> 2026 Feb/Mar low
cases.question: Does the sharp capitulation and rebound segment align?

cases.name: Rebound: 2022 Aug high -> 2026 May high
cases.question: Does the post-bottom rebound structure align?
